uutiset.t: F1 drivers back return of 'very cool' V8 engines in the future
uutiset.s: Formula 1's drivers appear to be unanimous with the prospect of V8 engine returning to the sport in the 2030s.

uutiset.s: Lauren Price believes becoming an undisputed champion could lead her to a showdown with American star Claressa Shields.

uutiset.t: Hamilton denies lack of trust with Ferrari after strategy issues
uutiset.s: Lewis Hamilton has insisted there is no lack of trust between himself and his Ferrari team despite having overridden orders from the pit wall twice in recent races.

uutiset.t: Van Gerwen: I need my A-game to beat Wade at Grand Slam
uutiset.s: Michael van Gerwen believes James Wade is "in some of the best form of his life" and says he'll need to bring his "A-game" in order to win their second-round meeting at the Grand Slam of Darts.

uutiset.t: Wattimena wins hearts with win vs Littler: 'Beat him, the crowd loves you'
uutiset.s: Jermaine Wattimena was visibly emotional following his massive 10-8 win over Luke Littler in the last 16 at the Grand Slam of Darts, taking in the moment as the Wolverhampton crowd sang his name.

uutiset.s: Veerle Buurman's late winner snatched a late 1-0 win for Chelsea against Paris Saint-Germain to move them to the top of the Champions League table.

uutiset.t: Littler stunned by Wattimena at Grand Slam of Darts
uutiset.s: Luke Littler's title defence at the Grand Slam of Darts is over after he suffered a 10-8 loss to Jermaine Wattimena in the last 16 in Wolverhampton.

uutiset.t: Cadillac confirm Bottas to stay with team for 2027
uutiset.s: Cadillac have confirmed Valtteri Bottas will stay on at the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season, ending speculation about the Finnish driver's future.

uutiset.t: Koepka 'disappointed' with PGA Tour season but 'beyond happy' to be back
uutiset.s: Brooks Koepka has dubbed his 2026 season a "a disappointment" but insists he is hungry to secure a spot on Team USA's 2027 Ryder Cup squad.

uutiset.t: Alcaraz defies fitness concerns to beat Medvedev
uutiset.s: Carlos Alcaraz kept up his strong end-of-season form with a 6-2 6-4 victory over Daniil Medvedev at the ATP Finals on Wednesday despite taking a medical timeout and getting his left thigh strapped.
